package.description: 免费开源的 Windows 快速搜索启动器：拼音搜文件、全文搜索 Word/Excel/PDF、剪贴板历史与 MCP 服务。

en-US.description: Windows search launcher with pinyin file search, document full-text search, clipboard history and an MCP server.
en-US.longDescription: WinShun (Win顺) is a free, open-source Windows search launcher and an alternative to Everything and Listary. Double-tap Ctrl to open the search box: find files and folders by pinyin, search the text inside Word, Excel and PDF documents, browse clipboard history instead of Win+V, search in dialogs and on the taskbar, extend it with plugins, and expose it to AI assistants through a MCP server. An optional index service reads the NTFS master file table and change journal, so WinShun itself runs with normal user rights and nothing it launches is elevated. Requires a 64-bit Windows 10 (version 1809 or later) or Windows 11.

zh-CN.description: 免费开源的 Windows 快速搜索启动器：拼音搜文件、全文搜索 Word/Excel/PDF、剪贴板历史与 MCP 服务。
zh-CN.longDescription: Win顺（WinShun）是一款免费、开源的 Windows 快速搜索启动器，可作为 Everything 与 Listary 的替代方案。双击 Ctrl 唤出搜索框：用拼音搜索文件和文件夹、搜索 Word/Excel/PDF 的正文内容、用剪贴板历史代替 Win+V、在对话框和任务栏里搜索、通过插件扩展能力，并以 MCP 服务接入 AI 助手。可选的索引服务负责读取 NTFS 主文件表和变更日志，因此 Win顺 平时以普通用户权限运行，由它打开的程序也不提权。需要 64 位的 Windows 10（1809 或更新版本）或 Windows 11。
zh-CN.name: Win顺
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Win 顺 0.24.0 让以管理员身份运行的程序不再是例外：剪贴板里选中的内容能直接粘贴进去，AutoCAD 和旧式“打开 / 另存为”窗口也能 Ctrl+G 跳转。闲置后第一次呼出更快，保存大索引的内存占用降到五分之一；插件关键字可以写多个，任务栏搜索框可以固定在托盘旁。另外修复设了“以管理员身份运行”时应用内更新后不再启动、搜索结果长时间发灰等问题。 WinShun 0.24.0 stops treating programs run as administrator as an exception: a clipboard entry is pasted straight into them, and AutoCAD and Windows XP style Open / Save dialogs follow Ctrl+G. The first opening after a quiet spell is faster and saving a large index takes a fifth of the memory; a plugin command can have several keywords, and the taskbar search box can stay beside the tray. Fixes include WinShun not coming back after an in-app update when set to run as administrator, and search results staying dimmed for seconds.
新功能 · What's new
- 📋 粘贴到管理员程序 以前在以管理员身份运行的程序里，从剪贴板选一条只会复制、再提示你自己按 Ctrl+V。现在由索引服务替你按这一次粘贴键，内容直接进去。在 设置 › 剪贴板 › 粘贴到以管理员身份运行的程序，默认打开；没装服务时和原来一样。
  Paste into administrators' programs In a program run as administrator, picking a clipboard entry used to copy it and ask you to press Ctrl+V yourself. The index service now presses that one paste chord for you. Under Settings › Clipboard, on by default; without the service it works as before.
- 📂 管理员权限的 CAD 和旧式对话框也能跳转 AutoCAD 以管理员身份运行时（一些插件会让它这样），Ctrl+G 和切回时自动跳转现在同样可用；没有地址栏的旧式“打开 / 另存为”窗口也一样。做法和手动操作相同：把文件夹填进文件名框、按一次确定，再把原来的文件名放回去。
  Administrators' CAD and old-style dialogs follow too With AutoCAD run as administrator (some add-ons make it so), Ctrl+G and going there on return now work, as they do in Windows XP style Open / Save dialogs with no address bar. It is done the way you would by hand: the folder goes into the file name box, OK once, and your file name is put back.
- ⚡ 闲置后第一次呼出更快 Win 顺 闲置时会把内存还给系统，下次呼出要一页页读回来，内存紧张时会慢。现在按下快捷键的同时就成批读回：固态硬盘上实测从 142–220 毫秒降到 90–107 毫秒。
  A faster first opening after a quiet spell WinShun gives memory back while idle, and the next opening had to read it back page by page, slow when memory is short. It is now read back in bulk as the hotkey goes down: 142–220 ms became 90–107 ms on an SSD.
- 🧩 插件关键字可以写多个 插件卡片的关键字框里，用空格分开的每个词都能触发（比如 try fy）。带引号的会标红并写明原因，不再悄悄丢掉；改过之后可以一键恢复“默认”。已装的插件满 8 个时，上方多一个筛选框。
  Several keywords for a plugin command In a plugin card's keyword box every word between spaces is a keyword (try fy). One with a quotation mark is marked with the reason instead of being dropped silently, and 默认 brings the plugin's own back. From eight installed plugins on there is a filter box above them.
- 📌 任务栏搜索框可以停在托盘旁 设置 › 打开 Win 顺 › 任务栏 › 搜索框位置 新增“托盘旁”：任务栏图标居中时也放在托盘图标左边，适合鼠标常在右下角的人。“自动”保持原来的规则。
  The taskbar search box beside the tray Settings › Open WinShun › Taskbar › Search box position gains Beside the tray: left of the tray icons with centred taskbar icons too, for a pointer that lives in that corner. Automatic keeps the previous rule.
- 🖼️ 拖出文件时显示它的样子 从结果里把文件拖出去，指针下是文件的缩略图或图标，多个文件带数量角标，不再是一个深色方块。按键被按下时图标会缩一下，点了没点一眼看得出。
  Files dragged out show their picture Dragging a result out shows its thumbnail or icon under the pointer, with a count badge for several, instead of a dark square. A pressed key now shrinks its icon, so a click is seen.
改进与修复 · Improvements and fixes
- 修复搜索结果长时间发灰：索引在后台频繁变化时，输入的搜索不再被一遍遍重新开始；内容扫描也不再拖住同时输入的文件名搜索。
  Results no longer stay dimmed for seconds: while the index changes in the background the typed search is not started over and over, and content scans no longer hold up a name search typed meanwhile.
- 保存索引时的额外内存降到约五分之一（3000 万条的测试：1143 MB 降到 211 MB，耗时 8.3 秒降到 1.9 秒）。反复读取的网络共享不再每读一次多出一批重复条目（#227）。
  Saving the index takes about a fifth of the extra memory (30 million entries: 1143 MB down to 211 MB, 8.3 s down to 1.9 s). A network share read again and again no longer gains duplicate entries at each reading (#227).
- WinShun.exe 属性里勾了“以管理员身份运行此程序”时：应用内更新后能正常启动新版本（#274）；拖动文件时的收藏圆盘也能出来了（#111）。
  With "Run this program as an administrator" ticked in WinShun.exe's properties, the new version starts after an in-app update (#274) and the drop pie appears when dragging files (#111).
- 文件夹里打字搜索时，“只在这个文件夹”“只看这一层”“也搜其他位置”固定在结果下方一行，不用滚到底才看得到（#246）。对话框旁的搜索框避开资源管理器的滚动条（#234），两行结果的间距在任何字体下都保持一致（#245）。
  When typing to search in a folder, the scope links sit in one line under the rows instead of after the last row (#246). The box beside dialogs keeps clear of Explorer's scroll bars (#234), and two-line rows keep their spacing with any font (#245).
- 搜索框右侧的历史、筛选、展开三个按钮统一成同一种大小和样式；类型标签只在单独按住 Ctrl 0.4 秒后才显示前缀，不再随每次 Ctrl+C 闪动（#279）。不能点击的行和卡片不再随鼠标变色。
  The history, filter and expand keys in the search box are one size and one kind; the type chips show their prefixes only after Ctrl has been held alone for 0.4 s, not at every Ctrl+C (#279). Rows and cards that cannot be clicked no longer light up under the pointer.
- 计算：2024-1987 这样的两个年份相减直接出结果，算式末尾带 = 也能算（#281）。
  Calculator: two years such as 2024-1987 subtract right away, and a sum with = after it computes too (#281).
- 剪贴板的显示进程不再在 %TEMP% 里每次启动留下两个文件夹，以前留下的也会清掉。
  The clipboard's display process no longer leaves two folders in %TEMP% at every start, and removes the ones left before.
插件库更新 · Plugin library updates

| 插件 · Plugin                         | 新版本 · Version |
| ------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| 截图与录屏 · Screenshot and recording | 1.1.10           |
| 图片文字搜索 · Image text search      | 1.0.10           |

两个插件跟进主程序的按键按下反馈等共用控件，没有各自的功能变化；最低版本分别为 0.18.0 和 0.23.0。社区插件方面，插件库现在接受“带管理员权限又复用 Win 顺 的 Qt”的插件（需写明最低 0.23.0），OCR Studio 和批量重命名 1.1.1 改为按回车才打开窗口。
Both plugins take over the shared controls of this release (keys that show a press) with no change of their own, requiring 0.18.0 and 0.23.0. In the community library, plugins with the elevated permission that use WinShun's Qt are now accepted (with minWinShun 0.23.0), and OCR Studio and Batch Rename 1.1.1 open their window on Enter instead of as their keyword is typed.
当前发布的验证范围见 0.24.0 发布验证记录。插件开发者请留意：instant 命令的说明已更正，query 在用户打字时就会到达，打开窗口这类动作请放在 action 里。
See the 0.24.0 release validation record for the verification scope. Plugin authors: the description of instant commands has been corrected; query arrives while the user types, so opening a window belongs in action.
